pipelineContract.sourcePriority: official assessor/appraiser, county GIS, municipal, state, or federal sources first
pipelineContract.identityRule: Do not emit countyParcelId until a complete duplicate-safe source key or documented composite key is proven.
pipelineContract.geometryRule: Preprocess county geometry at build time and publish viewport chunks, search shards, or PMTiles.
pipelineContract.failurePolicy: Preserve exact source, emitted, skipped, unmatched, duplicate, and null counts; never hide a discrepancy.
pipelineContract.activationRule: Keep the county disabled until its individual map/search, owner/appraisal, QC, and activation gates pass.
